Definition: Dropbacks : Total pass attempts plus sacks and scrambles.
Attempts : Total number of forward pass attempts.
Completions : Total number of successful pass completions.
Completion Percentage : (Completions / Pass Attempts).
Passing Yards : Gross yardage gained via the pass.
Yards per Attempt : Mean passing yardage per pass attempt.
Passing Touchdowns and Interceptions.

Big-Time Throw : A PFF Signature Stat. A pass with excellent ball location and timing, generally thrown further downfield and/or into a tight window. This metric excludes "dink and dunk" completions regardless of yardage.
Big-Time Throw Rate : Frequency of BTTs relative to total pass attempts.
Turnover-Worthy Play : A PFF Signature Stat. Passes with a high percentage chance of being intercepted or plays where the QB lacks ball security (fumbling).
Turnover-Worthy Play Rate : Frequency of TWPs relative to total dropbacks.
Average Depth of Target : The mean distance downfield at which a pass is aimed.
Adjusted Completion Percentage : The percentage of aimed passes thrown on target. Formula: (Completions + Drops) / Aimed Passes (excluding spikes, throwaways, etc.).
Drops / Drop Rate : On-target passes dropped by the receiver and the frequency thereof.
Batted Passes : Passes deflected by a defender at or near the line of scrimmage.
Hit As Thrown : Passing attempts where the QB is contacted by a defender during the release.
Thrown Away : Passes intentionally discarded to avoid a negative play or pressure.
Total Pressures : Cumulative count of Sacks, Hits, and Hurries generated by the defense.
Sacks : Number of times the passer was tackled behind the line of scrimmage.
Pressure-to-Sack Rate : Frequency at which a recorded pressure results in a sack; used to evaluate a QB’s pocket presence and the pass rush’s finishing rate.
Time to Throw : The mean time elapsed from snap to pass release or scramble.
Scrambles : Total undesigned rushing attempts initiated by the quarterback.
First Downs : Total passing plays resulting in a first down.
NFL Passer Rating : Standard league-wide efficiency metric.
